content.problemStatement: Write a program to find the majority in the array.Where the majority element is an element which appears in the array more than n/2 times.Hence there is atmost one such element.
content.inputFormat:
First line contains the number of elements.

 Second line has the array elements.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find majority element that appears more than N / 2 times.

code.Python3:
import sys
from collections import Counter
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    c = Counter(toks[1:n+1])
    for k, v in c.items():
        if v > n // 2: print(k); return
    print(-1)
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Use Boyer-Moore Voting algorithm or frequency map to find element appearing > N / 2 times.
